Process intro.paragraph: From the first conversation to the hundredth reorder, we keep things clear and on time.

Step 1 body.paragraph: We learn your concept, covers, service style and budget.

Step 2 body.paragraph: We shortlist products and brands, with samples where needed.

Step 3 body.paragraph: We confirm, consolidate and deliver on schedule across the UAE.

Step 4 body.paragraph: We handle replenishment, additions and new outlets as you grow.

style.How we work: flex-direction: column; padding: 120px max(40px, calc((100% - 1350px) / 2)); gap: 64px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; @media(--tablet){ padding: 96px 40px; gap: 48px; } @media(--mobile){ padding: 72px 20px; gap: 40px; } background: var(--on-navy);
style.Process ring outer: position: absolute; top: -200px; right: -240px; width: 700px; height: 700px; min-width: 700px; padding: 0px; border-radius: 50%; border-width: 1.2px; border-style: solid; border-color: rgba(201,150,46,0.35); z-index: 0;
style.Process ring inner: position: absolute; top: -110px; right: -150px; width: 520px; height: 520px; min-width: 520px; padding: 0px; border-radius: 50%; border-width: 1px; border-style: solid; border-color: rgba(201,150,46,0.2); z-index: 0;
style.Process head: padding: 0px; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end; gap: 40px; z-index: 1; @media(--tablet){ flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 28px; } @media(--mobile){ flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 24px; }
style.Process head left: flex-direction: column; gap: 22px; padding: 0px; width: 700px; max-width: 100%; align-items: flex-start;
style.Process label row: padding: 0px; width: auto; gap: 14px; align-items: center;
style.Process rule: width: 32px; min-width: 32px; height: 2px; padding: 0px; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, #A5740B 0%, #DEAF57 25%, #F1C96A 50%, #BE8826 75%, #A5740B 100%);
style.Process label: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 3px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--on-gold-soft); line-height: 1.2;
style.Process title: font-family: var(--on-serif); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.3px; font-size: 60px; line-height: 62px; color: #FFFFFF; @media(--tablet){ font-size: 46px; line-height: 50px; } @media(--mobile){ font-size: 36px; line-height: 40px; }
style.Process head right: flex-direction: column; gap: 24px; padding: 0px; width: 420px; max-width: 100%; align-items: flex-start;
style.Process intro: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 400; font-size: 16px; line-height: 28px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75);
style.Steps: padding: 0px; gap: 24px; align-items: stretch; z-index: 1; @media(--tablet){ flex-wrap: wrap; } @media(--mobile){ flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; }
style.Step 1: flex-direction: column; gap: 20px; padding: 40px 32px; flex: 1 1 0px; min-width: 0px; align-items: flex-start; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border-width: 1px; border-style: solid; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.14); @media(--tablet){ flex: 1 1 calc(50% - 12px); } @media(--mobile){ flex: 0 0 auto; width: 100%; padding: 32px 24px; }
style.Step 1 badge: width: 56px; min-width: 56px; height: 56px; padding: 0px; border-radius: 28px; border-width: 1.2px; border-style: solid; border-color: #A5740B; justify-content: center; align-items: center;
style.Step 1 num: font-family: var(--on-serif); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.3px; letter-spacing: 0px; font-size: 22px; line-height: 1; color: var(--on-gold-soft);
style.Step 1 mark: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 500; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.2; color: var(--on-gold-soft);
style.Step 1 title: font-family: var(--on-serif); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.3px; font-size: 36px; line-height: 37px; color: #FFFFFF;
